Follow us on @followmetraveller to see more backstage photos and stories of our current trip to Cambodia and Myanmar. 🌅  Here we are at the Beng Mealea temple. Being there you just can't believe that these structures are built by humans. They consist of a huge amount of perfect rectangle stones that are perfectly aligned against each other. Somewhere you wouldn't even be able to put a sheet of paper in the joint. There is no cement connecting those stones and they lay there for centuries. They say that elephants were used to lift and align them....and that it took 32-40 years to build it. Some structure in Europe that require far less amount of stones took 100-200 years to be built.🌅 Они говорят, что Эти храмы были построены в 12 веке и использовали слонов чтобы поднимать все эти камни наверх. Когда ты находишься там, то невозможно принять, что такие технологии существовали в те времена и были забыты. Эти блоки - идеальной прям угольной формы и стоят так близко друг у другу, что невозможно просунуть лист бумаги. Они не используют цемент и лежал под собственным весом. Говорят, что его построили за 32-40 лет. В это невозможно поверить, так как постройки с меньшим количеством необходимого камня занимали 100-200 лет!

The traditional recipe (that I have adulterated with a semi soft boiled egg) is #vegan #dairyfree #glutenfree and exceptionally delicious. If you fancy something new for breakfast then try this! ----------------------------
Served in cute new dishes from @royaldoultonuk

Tuesday: Melon bowl with seeds and beetroot coconut yoghurt (two beets and yoghurt in a blender!), blueberries, dragonfruit 🐲, passion fruit, tea and carrot juice 🍏🍎🍐🍊🍋🍌🍉🍇🍓🍈🍒🍑🍍
----------------------------
After the complete binge fest over the long Easter weekend I think it's time for a proper holiday. We're super happy to be joining @italian_eye in Tuscany 🇮🇹 for this years #Kaleidotour in April and then a romantic visit for just the two of us in NYC! #🇺🇸#🗽#🌈

Monday: Rabīciyya, a breakfast from medieval Baghdad. This is my adaptation of a dish from Kitāb al-Tabīkh, a 9th century cooking manual. I have used the translation Charles Perry in A Baghdad Cookery Book ------------------------------
The name of the dish comes from 'rabīc' meaning springtime. Leftover lamb from yesterday's Easter lunch with spices like ground coriander, cinnamon, cumin, mastic, ginger and dried jujube berries.  Served with a side of toasted Turkish bread and tahini with yoghurt #SymmetryBreakfast

Sunday: Hot Cross Bun, streaky bacon, fruit, freshly squeezed orange juice and Earl Grey tea. 
----------------------------
I'm jumping on the bandwagon, bacon hot cross bun sandwiches. They might be everywhere right now but we are super hungover. Have a great Easter everyone 🎉 #thanksjesus

Saturday: Colomba di Pasqua #🕊 soft fruit and a coffee #🇮🇹
---------------------------------------
The Colomba di Pasqua 🕊 is a traditional Italian Easter bread in the shape of a dove, covered in almonds and pearl sugar. I got mine from @fratellilunardi in Tuscany and stuck the mint in the mouth for some artistic license ---------------------------------------
The origins of its creation are debatable, but I find it a charming and far more delicious alternative to cheap chocolate eggs! #colombadipasqua #fratellilunardi

Friday: Homemade Semla #🇸🇪 #🇫🇮 with fruit and coffee
---------------------------
A super soft cardamom flavoured bun, hollowed out, filled with a marzipan cream, topped with whipped cream and then dusted with icing sugar. You're meant to eat these before the start of Lent but hey ho! They're delicious all year round if you ask me! 🎉 The recipe is by Bronte from @scandikitchen and is online #Semla #Laskiaispulla

Thursday: Tamales Peruanos #🇵🇪 Peruvian style tamales filled with olives, egg, raisins and nuts served with a simple fresh tomato and onion salsa and a glass of homemade Chicha Morada, a delicious spiced drink made with purple corn, pineapple and cinnamon 👌🏼#Peruvian #SymmetryBreakfast #chichamorada #tamale
---------------------------------------
The tamale recipe was submitted to me by @dantooley and @gracefully_frank and will be going in my book #CookLoveShare out this August 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉

Wednesday: Roti Jala from Malaysia #🇲🇾 🌾 Literally translates as "net bread". Mine are flavoured with pandan juice served with a papaya fruit boat ⛵️, carrot and mango juice and a cup of tea ☕️
-----------------------
Pandan also known as screwpine, is a long green leaf commonly found in South East Asian cooking. The flavour is similar to vanilla, but also coconut with more fragrance and aroma. They also colour everything bright green! ✅

Tuesday: Homemade (!) Pasteis de Nata #🇵🇹 a lovely coffee and a juicy juice, Raspberry, Apple, Ginger
---------------------------
I am quite proud of myself today, I've eaten many of these in my life, sometimes too many, Now I have perfected them in my own kitchen. I think I need to lie down now 😹 #pasteisdenata

Monday: Waffles with caramelised pears and vanilla salted caramel @halenmon 🌺🌻🌹🌷🌼🌸💐
----------------------------------------------
Have a great week everyone!! 😘😘😘😘😘😘😘😘😘😘 #symmetrybreakfast

Sunday: An Ulster Fry! Homemade potato farls and soda bread, sausage and bacon from @gingerpigltd, roast cherry toms, black pudding (a type of Blood Sausage) egg, beans on the side (a contentious issue with all cooked breakfasts, I'd like to hear your thoughts) and a cup of tea 👌🏼
-------------------------------
Everyone I hope is familiar with a Full English breakfast, the rich meaty gout fest, but did you know all over the British Isles of the regional variations? A Full Scottish, Welsh and Northern Ireland are all different and delicious! #🇬🇧 Which one is your favourite? 🎉 Beautiful new #glamping pans from @nethertonfoundry too!! #ulsterfry #northernireland

Saturday: Dippy eggs like you've never seen them before! 🐣 Veruca Salt realness! 🙋🏼Real chicken eggs, carefully emptied, cleaned and filled with hazelnut praline, buttery brioche soldiers for dipping with a cup of tea. A totally casual weekend breakfast 😜 #goldengoose #verucasalt #goodegg #badegg --------------------------------------------------Easter is just a week away! What have you got planned? These beautiful eggs from @fortnums 🐣 Served on incredible new ceramics from @1882ltd 😍

Friday: #🇯🇵 Miso Salmon, Ingen gomae-ae (string beans in a sweet and salty sesame dressing), tamagoyaki (rolled egg omelette sliced, kiwi berries for sweetness and pickles for tartness, my personal fave is the umeboshi plum 😍 Washed down with a cup of Moruchi Koucha, a rare black whole leaf tea from Japan --------------------------------------------------
Tableware is from all over today! @kaymetlondon trays, plates from @boroughkitchen @reikokanekoltd @tokyuhandsinc @timefortea.london #symmetrybreakfast

Thursday: A Green Feast! ☘🍀 Œufs Pistou #🇫🇷, toast and a cup of Sencha green tea 🍵 from Shizuoka, Japan #🇯🇵 @rareteacompany
----------------------
Pistou is the French version of Italian pesto without the pine nuts, usually served cold with soup. My version adds a Provençal twist to your morning meal. 💅🏼 Sencha, as with most green teas also pairs beautifully with umami rich foods like Parmesan, give it a go! 👊🏼 Have a great #StPatricksDay everyone! #🇮🇪 #symmetrybreakfast

Wednesday: Cassava Porridge with fruit, cinnamon, tea and juice. Eaten all over the world in particular West and Central Africa #🌍
------------------------
Cassava, also known as yuca, manioc or tapioca looks a bit like a potato and is full of nutrients. Some care is needed in preparing and cooking to avoid the risk of poisoning yourself! ☠ How do you like your cassava and where are you from?! #CassavaPorridge #SymmetryBreakfast

Tuesday: M'shewsha, a honey drenched cross between a pancake and a cake that is a popular breakfast in Algeria #🇩🇿 served with fresh fruit, a green juice (try not to be sick) with a caffe latte. Served on some lovely plates from @seraxbelgium #mshewsha #SymmetryBreakfast #CookLoveShare
-------------------
Say Hello! if you're from Algeria! #🇩🇿

Monday: Fatty Boy Baked Beans with an egg baked right in the middle, toast and butter, juice and tea
---------------------------------------------
My recipe for beans uses Polish boczek #🇵🇱and has a big tablespoon of miso paste stirred in at the end for a whole life time of umami. #CookLoveShare #SymmetryBreakfast
---------------------------------------------
Do you have a friend who is a fatty boom boom? 🙊

Sunday: Khao Niew Moo Ping - Marinade pork skewers with sticky rice and homemade jaew ข้าวเหนียวหมูปิ้ง #🇹🇭
---------------------------
In Thailand, this breakfast is enjoyed on the go! Overnight marinaded pork skewers, in fish sauce, soy, oyster sauce, clove, sugar and coconut milk with rice and a salty fishy sauce to dip #🇹🇭#ข้าวเหนียวหมูปิ้ง #🍢#🍚

Saturday: Churros with jamon in the batter #🇪🇸, homemade cajeta #🇲🇽; which is similar to dulce de leche but made with goats milk and panela, a cutie of a glass of Jugo de Avena, an oat milk drink from the Dominican Republic #🇩🇴, all knocked back with a cup of lovely tea ☕️

Friday: Okonomiyaki #🇯🇵 🎏🏮🎌🎊🎉🎈 A Japanese pancake that is in no way breakfast in Japan but I have the benefit of not being Japanese! Okonomiyaki literally means " Cooked however you like It" and is one of my favourite foods of all time, Mark's too 😍😍😍😍
------------------------------
Super simple and quick to make, the batter is full of shredded vegetables like cabbage and carrot. Topped with a layer of bacon and finished with kewpie Mayo, okonomi sauce, katsuobushi and aonori

Thursday: Frumenty (read below to find out more) with apple, blackberries, redcurrants, OJ and a caffe latte.
--------------------------
Y'all know how much I love history 🙋🏼, well this recipe was written 625 years ago! From one of the world's oldest cooking manuals. The Forme of Cury was written in the court of King Richard II and lives in the @britishlibrary. Frumenty is made with beer, spices and ancient grains and is still delicious today. My own version is going in my book #CookLoveShare #winning #formeofcury #foodhistory #frumenty

Wednesday: Split banana pancake cooked into the batter with yoghurt, nuts, fruit and a cup of Keemun tea 🎉🎉🎉
---------
Where the banana is cooked gives the best crunch and caramelised edges 💥💥💥
